name: AnythingLLM
description: All-in-one desktop and Docker app for chatting with documents and running AI agents, local by default.
whatItDoes: Lets individuals and teams chat with their documents in workspaces and automate tasks with built-in agents. The Docker version adds multi-user permissions and an embeddable chat widget.
howItWorks: A server, a front end and a document collector work together: the collector processes files, the server handles embedding, vector storage and LLM calls, and agents can call tools including MCP-compatible ones. It is distributed as a desktop app for Mac, Windows and Linux and as a Docker image; from source the three parts are started with yarn scripts.

requirements.name: LLM provider
requirements.description: Optional; runs with a local model by default

models: Local models and most hosted LLM providers
